maya: sec-alert — partner S3 logs (s3://partner-logs/prod/2026-03-21) contain multiple base64 blobs that look like wrapped Vault ciphertext. Not sure if this is full creds exfil but it's enough to warrant immediate sweep. https://logs.internal/abc123
sec-bot: automated-detection: cred-scavenger job matched 17 items across 3 objects. severity=high :rotating_light:
raj: ok locking down scope. immediate steps I suggest:
- disable SA keys for affected service-accounts
- create ephemeral Vault policy for affected apps
- run one-off vault rewrap/rewrap-keyflow against those ciphertexts
- schedule KMS wrap-key roll and record audit entries
olivia: +1. I can run the quick commands. prepping a script, will run in canary first. commands I plan to use:
```
# revoke keys
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=sa-ingest@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# run vault rewrap (example)
curl -sS -X POST "https://vault.internal/v1/sys/rewrap" -H "X-Vault-Token: $VAULT_TOKEN" -d '{"ciphertexts":["...base64..."]}'
```
olivia: also will trigger the cred-scan job with higher sensitivity: `./tools/cred-scan --bucket partner-logs --pattern vault-ciphertext --limit 1000`
tomas: for RBAC: can we add a short-lived binding instead of blanket privileges? recommend adding `roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser` for 1 hour to the k8s service identity and a deny rule on creation of new SA keys in the tenant org. also validate audit logs:
- GCP: `projects/REDWOOD/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity`
- KMS: check admin logs for key versions: `protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyRing\"` (rough example)
raj: I'll take ownership of the KMS wrap-key roll. plan:
1) create new key version in KMS (no auto-destroy)
2) update Vault transit/wrapping config to use new version
3) run rewrap for all affected ciphertexts
4) monitor logs + run smoke tests
please don't rollback until I post done.
raj: tagging @oncall — please hold deploys that create SA keys for the next 60m.
oncall: acknowledged. holding deploys and watching.
olivia: running canary rewrap now (will post results). if rewrap fails, we fallback to read-only mode for downstream ingesters.
olivia: canary done — rewrap 12/12 succeeded, latency ~120ms per item. posting snippet of output:
```
[2026-03-21T18:05:12Z] rewrap ok: s3://partner-logs/prod/2026-03-21/object1 (new_ct: aGVsbG8...)
```
maya: thanks team. I'll spin up a short runbook and open an incident ticket with these actions + timeline. assigning follow-ups: raj (kms roll + audit), olivia (rewrap sweep), tomas (rbac deny rule + org policy), maya (incident writeup + partner notif). :white_check_mark:
maya: adding note: after we finish, we need to do a credential blast-radius report (list of services that used those SA keys) and a partner outreach template — I'll draft the email.
